title: DNA Mimic Foldamer Recognition of a Chromosomal Protein
authors: Deepak Deepak; Valentina Corvaglia; Jiaojiao Wu; Lars Allmendinger; Ivan Huc
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DNA模拟折叠体与染色体蛋白Sac7d的互作，虽属蛋白-DNA互作体系且含结构解析，但对象非典型TF-DNA、方法以实验为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模，故为中档匹配。
abstract: Helical aromatic oligoamide foldamers bearing anionic side chains that mimic the overall shape and charge surface distribution of DNA were synthesized. Their interactions with chromosomal protein Sac7d, a non-sequence-selective DNA-binder that kinks and packages DNA, were investigated by Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR), Circular Dichroism (CD), and Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopies, as well as by single crystal X-ray crystallography. The foldamers were shown to bind to Sac7d better than a DNA duplex of comparable length. The interaction is diastereoselective and takes place at the DNA-binding site. Crystallography revealed that the DNA-mimic foldamers have a binding mode of their own and that they can bind to Sac7d without being kinked.
abstract_zh: 合成了带有阴离子侧链的螺旋芳香寡酰胺折叠体，这些折叠体模拟了DNA的整体形状和电荷表面分布。通过表面等离子体共振（Surface Plasmon Resonance, SPR）、圆二色光谱（Circular Dichroism, CD）和核磁共振（Nuclear Magnetic Resonance, NMR）光谱学，以及单晶X射线晶体学，研究了它们与染色体蛋白Sac7d（一种非序列选择性DNA结合蛋白，能使DNA弯曲并包装）的相互作用。结果表明，这些折叠体与Sac7d的结合能力优于长度相当的DNA双链。该相互作用具有非对映选择性，并发生在DNA结合位点。晶体学揭示，这些DNA模拟折叠体具有独特的结合模式，且能在不被弯曲的情况下与Sac7d结合。
